intent: Placeholder when a list, page, or region has nothing to show. One piece.
useWhen: A list or table has no rows
A page section has no content yet
A panel needs a centered placeholder with optional actions
Pick a kind: no-data (nothing in the range), no-results (a filter or search found nothing), first-use (nothing set up yet), permission (the person can't see it)
doNotUseWhen: Chart with no data — charts use their own emptyLabel
Loading with no content — use Spinner or LoadingAnimation
Something failed to load — use LoadError

title.note: The one sentence that says what happened, like "No invoice matches these filters." A heading at md and lg; plain text at sm.

icon.note: Overrides the kind's icon. Shown in the media tile (md, lg) or bare (sm). Not EmptyMedia. A curated Lucide name (PascalCase or kebab-case) renders instantly; any other Lucide name needs import "agentic-ds-kit/icons-on-demand" once (otherwise it is skipped with a dev warning). Or pass the Lucide component (Plus) or an element.

media.note: Custom media slot. Compose kit Avatar or AvatarGroup. Not EmptyMedia.

actions.note: Action row. Compose kit Buttons only. Not EmptyContent. Neutral sm Buttons, one verb each (Clear filters, Show 12 months, Request access). Only kind first-use may hold one primary Button; at lg, one primary and up to two neutral.

outlined.note: Bordered empty state with surface-card background.

kind.note: Why it is empty. Sets the default icon (ChartLine, SearchX, Plug, Lock) and the role: role=status for no-data, no-results and permission, so it is read once; no role for first-use. first-use gets the brand tile. Errors are not a kind: use LoadError. Leave it out for a plain placeholder with no role.

size.note: sm: in a chart, list or table cell. Bare 16px icon, title as one sentence with no heading, one neutral sm Button. md: a whole card body. 32px icon tile and a title; put card actions in the Card footer. lg: a page. 40px tile, heading-5 title, one primary and up to two neutral Buttons.

requirements: Title uses a heading element at md and lg; at sm it is a sentence
kind no-data, no-results and permission set role=status so the change is read once; first-use has no role
When it replaces a Skeleton it takes the same space and focus does not move

doNot: Do not invent EmptyHeader, EmptyMedia, EmptyTitle, EmptyDescription, or EmptyContent
Do not show a failure with Empty — use LoadError
Do not put a primary Button in Empty unless kind is first-use (or size lg on a page)
Do not write vague copy like Something went wrong or Nothing here — say what happened, then what to do
Do not use glass, color-mix, or backdrop-blur
snippet:
<Empty kind="no-results" title="No invoice matches these filters." actions={<Button size="sm" appearance="outline" mode="neutral">Clear filters</Button>} />
<Empty kind="first-use" title="Connect billing" description="Connect Stripe to see revenue." actions={<Button size="sm">Connect Stripe</Button>} />
